title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - ChemicalProperty
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/ChemicalProperty. A chemical property is a property of water that is related to chemical components. Subclass of WaterProperty per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the WaterProperty model and not repeated here. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology (used elsewhere as controlled-vocabulary values, e.g. as enum items of Water.hasProperty): Acrylamide, Aluminium, Ammonium, Antimony, Arsenic, Benzene, Benzoapyrene (label 'Benzo(a)pyrene'), Boron, Bromate, Cadmium, Chloride, Chromium, Copper, Cyanide, Epichlorohydrin, Fluoride, Iron, Lead, Manganese, Mercury, Nickel, Nitrate, Nitrite, Oxygen (labels 'Oxygen saturation'/'Dissolved oxygen'), PolycyclicAromaticHydrocarbons, Selenium, Sodium, Sulphate, Tetrachloroethene, TotalOrganicCarbon (label 'TOC'), Trichloroethene, Trihalomethanes, Tritium, VinylChloride, 12Dichloroethane (label '1,2-dichloroethane').

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ChemicalProperty'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
